name: hold
_note: the top hand curled a little over the bump (still q_k4_down_0; Harry on v5: 'rather than being a little curled over the top of the bump'): LONG fingers, together but fanned a few degrees so the tips step down in a diagonal, the curl mostly in the middle and end joints (~65-85° tip to knuckle, graded index least) so the fingertips bend down over the dome; the thumb tucked along the far side. Works with the hand placed palm DOWN onto the dome (hand_place --palm-down 0.55): with its palm normal pointing away from us a 3D curl only shortened the fingers (v6 first try at 70-85°: 'a mitten'; at 45-65°: 'straight planks').
